short_eof_behavior: EOF before advertised size does not emit upload-file-error or close; upload state remains active with sentbytes below size
idle_behavior: short-file upload remains active until connection idle closure path; closure emits file-connection-closed through timeout/idle path
growth_behavior: later read after an earlier EOF can still enqueue more bytes without restart
overshoot_behavior: sentbytes > advertised size misses exact == size completion event and upload state remains active
